Resolves #20512

Two fixes from the 13.4 header-groups matrix (#20379). A resized flex column now keeps its dragged width, and the header group cells follow a column resize live instead of snapping into place on mouseup.

- **Flex resize:** the flexbox layout keeps the `wrapperStyle.flex` it applied (`1 1 0%`) over `item.flex` (`Flexbox#applyChildAttributes`), and that flex outranks the width. `Resizable` now sets `flex: 'none'` on both the button and its wrapper style, in `onDragMove` and `onDragEnd`. The width then holds, and `Toolbar#isMeasuredWidth` measures the column as px. `onDragEnd`'s two assignments become one `set()`.
- **Live group cells:** `Body#updateCellPositions` moves `columnPositions` in place, but only the toolbar's measure (`Toolbar.mjs:456`) re-projected the group row. `onDragMove` now re-projects it right after the body update, with the same header-side call.

Evidence: L2 (real-pointer e2e on `examples/grid/headerGroups`) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs`, "a resized flex leaf takes the dragged width, and its group cell follows". At `origin/dev`, Dec stays at 528 px (`Expected: < 428`). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same spec, "the group cells follow a column resize while the drag is still live". It asserts alignment before `mouse.up()` and is red at `origin/dev`. |

## Deltas from ticket

The ticket proposed calling `project()` from `Body#updateCellPositions`. It is called from `Resizable#onDragMove` instead, which keeps the header group row a header concern (the toolbar's existing call is the precedent) and stops the body reaching into the header. `groupEdges` in the spec now skips drag-proxy clones, which carry the button's `aria-colindex` during a live drag.

## Test Evidence

- Red-first at `origin/dev` ccb30d8d6e: both new tests fail (`Expected: < 428, Received: 528`; live alignment `false`). A probe showed the drag running (`.neo-is-resizing`, a proxy present) while the inline `flex` stayed `1 1 0%`.
- At the branch head: `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` 18/18 (×2). The related resize specs (`ContentSizedRowsExample`, `HeaderResizeRectSync`) pass 32/32. Unit `grid/` passes 380.

## Post-Merge Validation

None required.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: `Resizable#onDragMove` and `onDragEnd` update `owner` (`Neo.grid.header.Button`) with `{flex: 'none', width: newWidth, wrapperStyle: ...}`, which satisfies `Toolbar#isMeasuredWidth` and survives cross-region button moves (`Wrapper#applyColumnButtonOrder` re-homes the live button instance via `toolbar.insert`), while the backing `Neo.grid.column.Base` instance in `grid.columns` retains its initial `flex` / `width` config. Because `createColumns` only builds fresh buttons when `grid.columns` is reassigned, any future consumer serializing column widths from `grid.columns` rather than `headerWrapper` / `columnPositions` would read the initial config rather than the user-dragged width (non-blocking; existing `Resizable` contract).
